data_fields.name: songCrossfadeMs
data_fields.donor_constant: 250 (fade out of old song and fade in of new song)

data_fields.name: tailDelayFraction
data_fields.donor_constant: one quarter of a step, or zero; no tail stops at two thirds of a step

data_fields.name: reduceVolumeTalking
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.66 of sound volume for Fireworks and Talking/ cues

best_idea: A looping movement sound follows a unit's path, fades out over one third of a step on arrival, and an end tail fires a quarter step later (or at once), with one voice per cue name so a name never overlaps itself.
decision_why: The timing rule (loop fades over a third of a step, tail at a quarter step or at once, silent at infinite rate) fits hero and creature step cues; the donor has no global voice cap or priority, so Frankendom must add both per class.
acceptance: When a hero moves along a path its step loop does not restart on each step, fades out over a third of one step after the last step, and the end cue starts a quarter step later; a client test asserts those times from the step length.
